issues.description: Duplicate React imports in auth/page.tsx - useEffect and useState are imported twice from 'react', causing a compile error
issues.root_cause: Line 2 has `import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'` and line 5 has `import { FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'` - duplicate named imports cause the SWC compiler to throw a 'defined multiple times' error

issues.description: Hydration mismatch errors - text content does not match server-rendered HTML
issues.root_cause: Likely caused by the duplicate import compile error triggering fallback rendering behavior, or dynamic content (e.g. date/time) rendered differently on server vs client

fixes.new_str:
import { Cormorant_Garamond, Manrope } from "next/font/google";
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate first import line that only imports useEffect and useState - the second import on line 5 already includes these plus FormEvent and useMemo, so the first import is redundant and causes the compile error
